accepted_anonymous_discovery.rule: Read-only metadata endpoints exposing public catalog / event schemas; no tenant data; IP-throttled

accepted_well_known.rule: RFC well-known endpoints (security.txt / openid-configuration / jwks / robots) — public by spec

accepted_management_command_views.rule: Verifier / management-command views (DEBUG-mode only or staff-gated path; AllowAny attached for OPTIONS preflight only)

accepted_pwa_offline_fallback.rule: PWA offline / install / manifest endpoints — service worker fetches require no auth; payload is static

accepted_signed_token_in_url.rule: Public URL with signed token (one-time activation / email-verify / password-reset-confirm) — token IS the auth

accepted_browser_csp_rum_beacon.rule: Browser-emitted reports that cannot bear auth; size-capped + IP-throttled + sanitized
